hero.title: Taught by someone who *learned by doing*
hero.lede: I’m Valentina, a native Italian. I teach Italian and Spanish at all levels, and French for beginners, to adults, teens and kids, in the Atlanta metro area and online.

chapters.heading: From the shop floor to *the lesson*
chapters.body:
My name is Valentina, and I’m Italian. I studied foreign languages and communication at the University of Turin, spent a year studying English at the University of Glamorgan in Wales, and learned Spanish at Proyecto Español, a language school in Alicante.

After that I spent seventeen years with an Italian multinational fashion company, training and coaching store teams across Europe, the Middle East and Russia. Over those years I worked with more than 300 fashion stores.

Nobody learns to run a shop floor from a textbook, and nobody learns to speak from one either. You learn by doing it, with someone who corrects you kindly and keeps you talking. That is how I teach.

I live in Atlanta now, and I teach every lesson myself: adults, teens and kids, one-on-one and in small groups, in person or online. I also teach for four language schools.

chapters.heading: Your reason first, grammar *when you need it*
chapters.body:
Every student starts with a reason: a trip, a family, a job, a test, or the pleasure of it. I ask about it on the free call and build the lessons around it, so the first things you learn are the things you will say.

We talk from the first lesson. I correct you kindly and keep you talking, and grammar comes in when it helps you say what you want to say.

I suggest two hours a week: enough to make real progress, light enough to keep up.
chapters.imageAlt: Hands mid-sentence over a notebook and an espresso cup

chapters.heading: Italian, Spanish *and French*
chapters.body:
[Italian](/italian-classes-atlanta/) is my native language. I teach it from complete beginner to business level, including preparation for the Italian language test for citizenship.

[Spanish](/spanish-classes-atlanta/) I learned at Proyecto Español in Alicante. I teach it from beginner to business level too.

French is for beginners. You start from zero and talk from the first lesson, and if you are going to France we build the lessons around your trip, the same way as [Italian for travel](/italian-for-travel/).
